page_status.title: Corrected air interfaces and moving-hose study for one brake.
page_status.summary: The89mm port datum, exact tangent hoses and separate unresolved thread reservations are in the CAD.149 prior parts are preserved.40 constant-length hose curves and10 rigid assembly poses were checked. Supplier fit, maximum force, actual fixed hose hardware, strength qualification and installed service remain open.

actual_changes: Physical PORT97/PORT116 labels avoid an unverified circuit assignment
Exact cubic annular hose sweeps remove the sampled-chord junction artifacts
Unknown below-face fitting threads are separate hidden interface reservations; no port cavities invented
Unsupported generic pad box removed; source service sequence and bounded chamber-removal screen recorded

rotor.selection_status: Conditional catalog envelope only; no fabrication release.
rotor.reason: No investigated alternative provides the missing exact annulus and toleranced mating section. Switching to a 173 mm pilot rotor would add a new hub interface without closing the fit evidence.
rotor.interchange_conclusion: Do not treat S-33391, CT826, M44D75180, MPBR75180 or DuraBrake 75180 as dimensionally interchangeable in a custom hub merely because catalogs cross-reference them. This rejects an unproved equivalence; it does not prove that manufacturer-approved replacements cannot fit an original OEM hub.

chamber.cad_change_recommendation: Retain0250 geometry; correct independently dimensioned port-face height from88 to89mm. Do not substitute0460 or22/24 without complete package evidence.
chamber.reason: Manufacturer-supported0460/0450 candidates improve replacement traceability but do not close maximum force, exact supply, controlled caliper mating datum or rail application acceptance.

strength_status: READ-ONLY REVIEW; NO MOUNTED-BRAKE RATING OR METAL CHANGE
deferred: Full air distribution and anti-compounding circuit
release_holds: Exact rotor annulus, toleranced hub/hat section, bolt engagement and compatible pad/caliper package are not established. Catalog cross-references do not authorize automatic substitution.

WABCO9253800250 is retained as a legacy development reference; the manufacturer-listed0460 alternative is not selected or qualified. Exact supply, maximum service/parking force and combined-force cases remain open.
The chamber/caliper axial mating datum and complete OEM material contours remain provisional. The source-supported89mm port-face ordinate does not establish boss or port-cavity geometry.
The8mm thread insertion and20mm fitting envelope are explicit scenarios. Two below-face interface reservations remain unresolved; separating them is not a physical-clearance acceptance.
Cast11 means service and cast12 means spring/parking, but their assignment to the97/116mm axial port stations is not established.
Forty constant-length hose curves are geometric samples. Actual fixed fittings/clamps, straight leads, cut lengths, torsion allowance, pressure growth and flex/abrasion validation remain open.
The chamber withdrawal screen excludes the unknown caliper mating seat and actual tools. Pad/retainer/spring/pressure-plate extraction and caging/tool access are not accepted.

Actual maximum brake torque, bearing application/minimum load, fits, key contact, bolt preload, weld fatigue, materials and vehicle dynamic loads remain unqualified.10kNm is a comparison load, not a brake rating.
Only one brake installation is modeled. Remaining locations, full service/spring air distribution and anti-compounding circuit are deferred.
Discrete geometry samples do not establish continuous motion, manufacturing tolerances, structural flexure or an operating release.
